raw: {"verdict":"pass","reason":"The new shared `phone` schema strips spaces, dashes, dots and parentheses, then applies the old `^\\+?\\d{10,15}$` check. Both public routes use the normalized `parsed.data.phone`, so booking and waitlist store `+77015551234` and upsert to one client. Inputs like `call me` and `+7 701` are still rejected."}
